business_summary.text: Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited is a Navi Mumbai-based B2B manufacturer of lightweight casting gold and diamond-studded jewellery, supplying major Indian and Middle-East jewellery retailers.

call_points.text: Company targets net-debt-free status through improved operating cash flow.
Value-added share of business rose from under 10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, driving gross margin.
ERP adoption cut gold loss from 1.5% to 0.5%.
Advance gold was 11.5% of FY26 volumes and is targeted at ~30% by FY30.
London expo produced an initial order book of ₹30-45 Cr from UK and Europe buyers.
Natural diamonds are ~2% of business, with an aim to double that contribution.
Promoters will draw no salary from FY27; payouts will be only through dividends.
M S K A & Associates LLP (BDO International) appointed statutory auditors; it reviewed this quarter.
Akash Talesara appointed CEO, with over two decades in gems and jewellery.
Capacity expansion shifts to leased facilities under an asset-light model, aligned with customer demand.
Land asset to be monetised, with proceeds expected to cut net borrowings by about 20%.
Advance gold, where customers supply the metal, is expected to reach ~30% of volumes by FY30 from 11.5% in FY26.
Value-added products rose to ~50-55% of business in FY26 from under 10% in FY23.
Gold loss cut to 0.5% from 1.5% after ERP implementation.
PAT margin expected to improve 10-20 bps year-on-year as the company invests in new geographies.
Promoters will not draw salary from 1 April 2026; payouts will be only through dividends from operating cash flows.
India Ratings upgraded bank loan rating to IND A/Stable/IND A1 from IND A-/Stable/IND A2+.
M S K A & Associates LLP (BDO member firm) appointed statutory auditor, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM.

operating_notes.text: Statutory auditor V J Shah & Co. resigned effective May 8, 2026, due to increased audit scope from two newly acquired subsidiaries.
Board approved appointment of M/s. M S K A & Associates LLP as Statutory Auditors on May 9, 2026, to fill casual vacancy until the ensuing AGM.
Appointed M S K A & Associates LLP as Statutory Auditors subject to shareholder approval.
Changed depreciation method from WDV to SLM effective April 1, 2025.
FY26 revenue reached ₹6,295 Cr with EBITDA margin at 6.9%.
Value-added share of business rose from under 10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, the stated driver of gross margin expansion.
Advance gold was 11.5% of FY26 volumes; the model bills only making charges, so its revenue contribution appears modest but it needs near-zero working capital.
Manufacturing capacity is 14.4 tonnes per year across 1,50,000 sq ft, with ~180 designers and 1,500 employees.
Internal auditor changed from Ms. Aasna Shah (resigned, effective 16 October 2026) to M/s Doshi Jain & Co. (FRN: 141851W), a 2015-founded firm with 5 partners and over 150 professionals.

timeline.summary: Statutory auditor V J Shah & Co. resigned across Sky Gold and its subsidiaries due to expanded audit scope from new acquisitions.
Sky Gold's Board approved the appointment of M/s. M S K A & Associates LLP as Statutory Auditors to fill the casual vacancy until the ensuing AGM, subject to member approval.
Sky Gold and Diamonds announced the appointment of M S K A & Associates LLP as statutory auditors, subject to shareholder approval.
SKY GOLD AND DIAMONDS LIMITED’s **Mangesh Chauhan** (MD) invites analysts to a **conference call on May 28, 2026, at 02:00 PM (IST)** to discuss Q4 & FY 2025-26 results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,911.51 Cr (+80.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹84.28 Cr.
Sky Gold reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,295 Cr, up 77.4% YoY, and an upgraded credit rating of IND A/Stable.
Sky Gold and Diamonds made available the audio recording of its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call held on May 28, 2026.
Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited’s management, led by Whole Time Director Mahendra Chauhan, will participate in an in-person roadshow in Mumbai on June 5, 2026.

Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited’s officials, including Whole Time Director Mahendra Chauhan, held an in-person Analyst/Investor Meeting with a Group of Investors on June 2, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM (IST).
Q1FY27 (Aug 2026): Sky Gold reported revenue of ₹2,012.8 Cr (+77.9% YoY) and PAT of ₹104.9 Cr (+140.7%), and raised FY27 revenue guidance to ~₹8,100 Cr.
2026-10-16: Sky Gold board approved the appointment of M/s Doshi Jain & Co. as internal auditor, replacing Ms. Aasna Shah who resigned.
